privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: At TryRecruiters, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website and services.
privacyPolicy.description: Read the full Privacy Policy and download the PDF version if you need an offline copy.
privacyPolicy.viewPdf: Open the PDF in a new tab

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.description: We collect information you provide directly and information collected automatically:
items: Personal identification information (name, email, phone number, location)
Employment information (job title, company, experience, resume/CV)
Profile information (professional background, skills, certifications)
Communication data (messages, feedback, support requests)
Payment information (processed securely through PayPal)
Device and usage data (IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent)

howWeUseInformation.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInformation.description: We use the collected information for:
items: Providing and improving our services
Matching candidates with job opportunities
Processing payments and managing subscriptions
Sending communications (newsletters, updates, notifications)
Analyzing usage patterns and site performance
Complying with legal obligations
Preventing fraud and ensuring security

informationSharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
informationSharing.description: We may share your information with:
items: Service providers and partners necessary to operate our platform
Employers and recruiters (for job matching, with your consent)
Legal authorities when required by law
Business partners in case of merger or acquisition

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.description: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.description: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
items: Right to access your personal data
Right to correct inaccurate data
Right to delete your data (right to be forgotten)
Right to restrict processing
Right to data portability
Right to object to processing

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, remember your preferences, and analyze site usage. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

thirdPartyLinks.title: 8. Third-Party Links
thirdPartyLinks.description: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. Please review their privacy policies before providing any information.

childrenPrivacy.title: 9. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.description: Our services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover we have collected information from a child under 13, we will delete it immediately.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or by posting the updated policy on our website. Your continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:
contact.address: Address: 6391 Elgin St. Celina, Delaware 10299, New York, États-Unis d'Amérique

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using TRYRECRUITERS, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully. This document includes our Confidentiality Agreement and User Agreement.
terms.acceptanceNote: By clicking 'Sign Up', 'Create Account', or any similar reference, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by this Agreement in its entirety.

s1.title: Introduction
s1.body: Welcome to TRYRECRUITERS! Your privacy is important to us. This Confidentiality Agreement explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information when you use the App. By creating an account and using the App, you agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set out in this Agreement.

sub1.title: Information You Provide to Us
items: Account Information: your name, email address, password, CV, and other necessary information.
Profile Information: optional additions such as a profile picture, phone number, and other details.
Content: any information or content you provide, upload, or share through the App.

sub2.title: Information We Collect Automatically
items: Device Information: hardware models, operating systems, and unique device identifiers.
Usage Information: access times, pages viewed, and actions taken.
Location Information: via IP address, GPS, or other location-based technologies.

sub1.title: To Provide and Improve Our Services
items: To create and manage your account.
To personalize your experience and provide content tailored to your interests.
To respond to your comments and questions and provide tailored customer service.

sub2.title: For Communication
items: To send technical notices, updates, security alerts, and support messages.
To provide information about new features, services, and promotions.

sub3.title: For Security and Fraud Prevention
items: To monitor and analyze usage and activities to ensure the security of the App.
To detect, prevent, and address fraud, unauthorized activities, and access.

sub4.title: Legal Compliance
sub4.body: To comply with legal obligations, enforce our agreements, and protect the rights, property, and safety of TRYRECRUITERS, our users, and others.

sub1.title: With Service Providers
sub1.body: We may share your information with third-party vendors, consultants, and other service providers who need access to your information to perform work on our behalf.

sub2.title: For Legal Reasons
sub2.body: We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to a legal request, such as a court order, subpoena, or government investigation.

sub3.title: Business Transfers
sub3.body: We may share or transfer your information in connection with any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by another company.

sub1.title: Access and Update
sub1.body: You can access and update your personal information through your account settings.

sub2.title: Delete Account
sub2.body: You can delete your account at any time, which will remove your profile and associated data from our systems.

sub3.title: Unsubscribe
sub3.body: You can opt out of receiving promotional communications by following the instructions in those communications or through your account settings.

s6.title: Data Security
s6.body: We implement various security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

s7.title: Data Retention
s7.body: We retain your personal information as long as necessary to achieve the purposes described in this Agreement unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

s8.title: Children's Privacy
s8.body: Our App is not intended for children under 18 years old. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If we become aware that we have inadvertently received personal information from a user under 18, we will delete such information from our records.

s9.title: Changes to This Confidentiality Agreement
s9.body: We may update this Confidentiality Agreement from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new Agreement on the App and updating the 'Effective Date.' Your continued use of the App after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised Agreement.

s10.title: Contact Us
s10.body: If you have any questions about this Confidentiality Agreement, please contact us at

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find quick answers to the most common questions about our services and processes
faq.q1: How can I create an account?
faq.a1: To create an account, click on the "Register" button at the top of the page. Choose your account type (Candidate or Recruiter) and fill out the form with your information. You will receive a confirmation email to activate your account.
faq.a2: Our team is committed to responding to all requests within 24 to 48 business hours. For urgent questions, please do not hesitate to contact us by phone.
faq.q3: How to post a job offer?
faq.a3: After creating a recruiter account, log in to your space and click on "Post a job". Fill in the job details, define your criteria and publish. Your offer will be visible immediately after validation.
faq.a4: Registration and consultation of offers are completely free for candidates. For recruiters, we offer several packages adapted to your needs. Contact us for more details on our rates.
faq.q5: How to modify my profile information?
faq.a5: Log in to your account and access your personal space. Click on "My profile" then on "Edit". You can update your personal information, your CV, and your preferences at any time.
faq.q6: What to do if I forgot my password?
faq.a6: On the login page, click on "Forgot password?". Enter your email address and you will receive a link to reset your password. The link is valid for 24 hours.
faq.contactUs: Our team is here to help you. Feel free to contact us.
